prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Wide 16:9 portal key art in exquisite hand-painted ink-and-gouache storybook fantasy style matching meadow reference. Aerin, brown hair, cream tunic, leather boots, dark teal gold-hemmed cape, sword, seen from behind on the south cobbled road looking toward a forgotten medieval clock-tower city. Central distant tall clock tower, gate, pitched roofs, warm amber lanterns, cool blue-grey mist. Rich painterly paper texture, delicate ink outlines, muted sage and slate, warm highlights. Hero and tower near center-right, darker unobtrusive left side for live HTML copy. No text, logos or watermark.
